parameters.name: Architecture
parameters.description:
The system architecture. Valid values:</br>

- x86_64

Currently, only x86_64 is supported.

parameters.name: ComputeType
parameters.description:
The image type. Valid values:

- ens_vm: ENS virtual machine image (default)

parameters.name: DiskDeviceMapping
parameters.description: The list of custom image information.

sub_parameters.name: OSSBucket
sub_parameters.description: The OSS bucket that stores the image.

sub_parameters.name: OSSObject
sub_parameters.description: The file name (key) of the image file stored in the OSS bucket after the image is uploaded.

sub_parameters.name: OSSRegion
sub_parameters.description: The region where the image resides.

parameters.name: ImageFormat
parameters.description:
The image format. Valid values:</br>
qcow2.</br>
Currently, only qcow2 is supported.

parameters.name: ImageName
parameters.description: The image name. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter and cannot start with http:// or https://.

parameters.name: LicenseType
parameters.description: The image license type. Valid values: Aliyun (Alibaba Cloud license) and BYOL (Bring Your Own License).

parameters.name: OSSBucket
parameters.description: The OSS bucket that stores the image file.

parameters.name: OSSObject
parameters.description: The name of the image file.

parameters.name: OSSRegion
parameters.description: The region where the image resides. Currently, only cn-beijing is supported.

parameters.name: OSType
parameters.description:
The operating system platform type. Valid values:

- windows
- linux

Currently, only linux is supported.

parameters.name: OSVersion
parameters.description: The version of the operating system distribution.

parameters.name: Platform
parameters.description:
The operating system distribution. Valid values:
- centos
- ubuntu

parameters.name: TargetOSSRegionId
parameters.description:
The region of the destination OSS where the image is stored.</br>

> Currently, only cn-beijing and ap-southeast-1 are supported.
